verdict.rationale: The evidence shows Semgrep analyzes code locally and by default never uploads it (semgrep-gh-2), and that `--dry-run` keeps scan results from being sent to the web app (semgrep-docs-33). Keeping data off Semgrep's servers indirectly keeps it out of any training pipeline. However, nothing in the pack addresses AI training policy, even though Semgrep offers AI features such as Assistant and AI-Powered Detection. Missing for 10: an explicit statement that customer code and findings are not used to train AI models, a training opt-out control, data-handling terms for the AI features, and independent corroboration.
